channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Nov 05
item.description:
51 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • NPC phone calls now ignore the MaxConcurrentCalls limit, allowing more simultaneous calls.
  • NPC encounters now run reliably after timer error fix.

NPC & AI

  • NPC phone calls now ignore the MaxConcurrentCalls limit, allowing more simultaneous calls.

Inventory & Crafting

  • Moving items to or from slot 7 of a backpack no longer triggers equip/unequip events, fixing incorrect backpack behavior.
  • Contact list notes are now saved correctly.
  • Supply drops in the Primitive game mode now include blueprint pages.

Events

  • Coast runs during the scientist boat event now function correctly, with the group approaching and driving along the shore in formation.

Wildlife

  • Rockets now correctly collide with large seagull group colliders, and seagulls no longer disappear when they can't find a landing spot.

Controls & UI

  • Fixed a NullReferenceException causing control focus issues, improving gamepad and UI responsiveness.

World & Terrain

  • Adjusted the radius of Lake C and Oasis B slightly and refined terrain blending, resulting in smoother terrain transitions and slightly larger water bodies.

Gameplay & Balance

  • NPC encounters now run reliably after timer error fix.

Demo & Recording

  • Demo export no longer capped at 240 fps and low timescale stutter resolved, enabling smoother recordings.

Graphics & Visibility

  • Distance flares render correctly without over‑brightening, fixing HDR gamma conversion issue.

Settings & Performance

  • Default server settings regenerated, updating outdated convars and setting max shadow quality to a sensible default.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Locked crate UI now shows correct timer after restarts.

Cosmetics & Identification

  • Thrown weapons correctly retain or drop skins during flight, fixing visual inconsistencies.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Nov 04
item.description:
117 development commits

Combat & Weapons

  • Reload animation now resets correctly when switching identical guns, preventing unintended continuous reloads.
  • Ballista bolts are functional again, restoring ranged siege capability.
  • Melee attacks no longer cause crashes, ensuring stable combat.
  • Turrets now fire at their intended automatic rate when placed.

Vehicles & Transportation

  • Tomaha snowmobile can be prepared without errors, restoring its use.
  • Railway tracks no longer become buried by terrain; a world‑setup step raises them, improving rail visuals and workcart operation.

World & Spawn

  • Hoppers now correctly collect body bags.
  • Beach spawn points fixed: players spawn only on true beaches, and lighthouses no longer appear inland.
  • Lighthouse and brown crates now spawn above ground, making loot accessible.

AI & Animals

  • Snakes now collide properly with world layers, no longer ride horses, and take explosion damage as intended.

Items, Loot & Decay

  • Alien costume is craftable again.
  • Seagull corpses now drop extra resources.
  • Stashes decay over time again, with adjustable duration via a console variable.

World & Mechanics

  • Dynamic monument map markers can now update their label and position in real time, improving navigation to changing points of interest.
  • Rail lifts no longer suffer from floating rails at junctions, preventing visual glitches and potential traversal issues.
  • Old cave monument prefabs have been removed from procedural generation, cleaning up cave layouts.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Water wheel control menu no longer crashes due to a null reference, restoring access to wheel settings.
  • Tattoo files are now stored correctly after merging, ensuring player tattoos persist and display properly.
  • Opening the items tab during loading no longer triggers a UI error, allowing smoother inventory access.
  • Item pickup notifications are fixed, so players receive proper feedback when collecting items.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Nov 03
item.description:
104 development commits

Combat & Weapon Reliability

  • Magazines no longer disappear when swapping weapons during a reload.
  • Turrets always apply the stock's extended properties, ensuring consistent performance regardless of stock configuration.

Building & World Interaction

  • Biofuel generators now snap correctly in corners when using advanced snapping.
  • Placing or destroying a door updates only that door on the server, eliminating unnecessary refreshes of all doors.
  • Players can no longer become trapped in computer stations; additional dismount points and notifications prevent stuck situations.

Loot, Crates & Economy

  • Uzi weapons now appear as loot in new hackable, elite, and underwater crate types, with drop weights adjusted to avoid overlap and include ammunition.
  • Food stored in loot containers remains fresh until the container is opened or the item is removed, with an option to control this behavior.

Combat Feedback

  • Patrol helicopter rocket kills now correctly display the helicopter on the death screen and credit the kill to the helicopter.

Stability & Performance

  • Deep sea water height updates no longer allocate excessive memory, preventing major client crashes.
  • Opening the inventory during a phone conversation no longer crashes the game.
  • Rejoining a server no longer triggers a boat wake error; destroyed boats are properly removed from visual effects.
  • Fixed a prefab syntax issue that could cause structures to fail loading or behave incorrectly.

Combat & Item Interaction

  • Blood effect no longer appears when shearing sheep.
  • Dropping items from the belt while in inventory no longer unintentionally removes the held item.
  • Triangular prism deployable splash damage area expanded to include grills and triangle hatches, increasing its effectiveness.

World & Environment

  • Shore ice will no longer spawn on top of railway tracks, preventing unrealistic ice coverage.
  • Roadside water pipes no longer appear on roads at T‑junctions, cleaning up road visuals.
  • Bunker entrance terrain blend adjusted to match monument footprint, removing stray paint data and improving visual consistency.
  • RadTown monument blend radius slightly reduced and smoothed to prevent overreach beyond its intended area.
  • Jungle Ruins D terrain tile size reduced, cutting unnecessary blend area and improving performance.

Audio & Visual Effects

  • Binoculars now correctly display their screen overlay even with domain reload disabled.
  • Tutorial cinematic camera position fixed, ensuring proper view during the tutorial.
  • Phone conversation UI now shows accurate information after server commands are used.
  • Bird flock sounds now respect proper distance attenuation, making distant flocks quieter.

UI & Store

  • Scrap King building skin Steam item now correctly displays “Upgrade to Scrap King” instead of a generic token.
